scene: The popped lunchbox projects holographic transit passes across the breezy rooftop.
picture: Side-scrolling flat view across the high rooftop platform. On the far left, an upside-down revolving door lift hums with yellow light. Centre-left, the girl in her windbreaker holds her sketchbook, beside the open pink lunchbox beaming holograms. Up high hangs a stationary wicker gondola, while on the right idles a brass carousel train.
shown: a striped revolving door lift standing open on the far left
a dangling wicker gondola waiting hooked to a cable up high
a miniature clockwork carousel train idling on a rail on the right
